message: 倒すべきは……？
In the end, I caught Macaron's cold and spent the entire weekend stuck in bed.
Macaron's cold cleared up completely, so that was good, though.
Besides, having Macaron nurse me back to health wasn't half bad...

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'm gonna head on ahead.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, why?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's walk together. We're all heading to the academy anyway.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm trying to be considerate here. Read the room.」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's that mean?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who knows. Catch ya in class.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nana-oneechan's acting weird.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure is.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hey, Onii-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Macaron
message: 「What do you think about the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「What do I think?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, how would you feel if I became a full-fledged Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I'd think it's amazing.」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's all?」

name: Synn
message: 「It means you achieved your goal, right? Isn't that a great thing?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You wouldn't start seeing me differently than before, or anything?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'd probably look up to you. Makes me feel like I need to follow your example, too.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Oh, I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「...Right, of course. You're my Onii-chan, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what about it?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, it's nothiiing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「What was I even worrying about so weirdly for...」

name: Macaron
message: 「There's no way Big Brother would hate someone over something like that, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you're planning out another match again?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Eh? A-ah, well, yeah!」

name: Synn
message: 「All riiight, I'm not gonna lose next time either--」

name: Synn
message: 「You just keep getting stronger and stronger, Macaron, so I can't let my guard down either.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe, o-of course I am!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Awu... Big Brother and the others are getting just as strong too, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder when you're gonna surpass me--」

name: Macaron
message: 「S-Soon, obviously!」

name: Macaron
message: 「...What should I do.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I have a match with Big Brother and the others now, will I be able to fight seriously...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nuh-uh, I can't run away!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I'm going to call myself the Demon Lord, this is something I can't avoid!」

name: Macaron
message: 「And there's something I have to tell Big Brother too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Let me know again once you decide when we're having our match.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Melphas
message: 「A private consultation, you say... Just what sort of matter might this be.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Listen up, do you know anyone strong?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Someone way, way stronger than the Crusaders!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, I see. So you were searching for someone powerful.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. A Demon General or whoever, anyone works!」

name: Melphas
message: 「I must admit, I am having some trouble grasping your intentions, Princess...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Um, basically...」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I beat someone stronger than the Crusaders, wouldn't that make me stronger than the Crusaders?」

name: Macaron
message: 「See, we already know each other's moves pretty well, so...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I figured there's not much point in fighting each other anymore~」

name: Melphas
message: 「I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Besides, I've gotten pretty strong myself, so I wanna prove my strength against someone totally different!」

name: Melphas
message: 「...I believe I grasp the gist of your reasoning, Princess.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Do you still feel hesitant about crossing blades head-on with the President, perhaps?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I-It's not like that at all!」

name: Melphas
message: 「No, no, it is quite alright.」

name: Melphas
message: 「If that is the case... it is not as though no one comes to mind.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Huh, who?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Among the Seven Demon Generals, there is a man named Bylous...」

name: Melphas
message: 「He is a berserker who has staked his entire life on duels to the death against the strong.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Having reached the very pinnacle, word has it he desires a bout with the Demon Lord who will quell Re-Crea.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Bylous...」

name: Melphas
message: 「His prowess stands head and shoulders above the other Demon Generals.」

name: Melphas
message: 「In all likelihood, he may even surpass the Nive Clan.」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I beat him... I'll be the Demon Lord...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'll do something about that Re-Crea thing, bring peace to the Demon World and the Human World, and with Big Brother too...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Alright! I'm gonna do my best!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If it's me, I know I can totally do it!」

name: Melphas
message: 「Please, do not let your guard down for even a moment...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine. Thanks, Melphas.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Not at all, it's no trouble at all.」

name: Melphas
message: 「Allow me to see just how capable the princess truly is...」
